title_en: Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning Enforcement Guarantee

articles.content_en: Article 1 For the purposes of these Provisions, "execution guarantee" refers to a guarantee provided by a guarantor to the People's Court in accordance with Article 231 of the Civil Procedure Law to secure the performance by the person subject to execution of all or part of the obligations determined in a legally effective legal instrument.
Article 2 An execution guarantee may be provided by the person subject to execution by means of property security, or by another person by means of property security or suretyship.

Article 3 Where the person subject to execution or another person provides an execution guarantee, he shall submit a guarantee instrument to the People's Court and deliver a copy of the guarantee instrument to the applying party for execution.

Article 4 The guarantee instrument shall state the basic information of the guarantor, the period of suspension of execution, the guarantee period, the type and amount of the secured claim, the scope of guarantee, the method of guarantee, and the undertaking that the guarantor voluntarily submits to direct compulsory execution if the person subject to execution still fails to perform after the expiration of the period of suspension of execution.
Where property security is provided, the guarantee instrument shall also state the name, quantity, quality, condition, location, and ownership or right-of-use attribution of the secured property.

Article 5 Where a company provides an execution guarantee for the person subject to execution, it shall submit the company's articles of association and the resolution of the board of directors or the shareholders' meeting or the general meeting of shareholders that comply with Article 16 of the Company Law.

Article 6 Where the person subject to execution or another person provides an execution guarantee and the applying party for execution consents, the applying party shall issue a written consent opinion to the People's Court; alternatively, the execution personnel may record the content of such consent in the record, and the applying party shall sign or affix a seal thereto.

Article 7 Where the person subject to execution or another person provides property security, the formalities for public notice of security interest, such as registration, may be handled in accordance with the Property Law and the Security Law; where such formalities have been completed, the applying party for execution may claim the right to priority of repayment according to law.
Where the applying party for execution applies to the People's Court to seal up, seize, or freeze the secured property, the People's Court shall permit it, unless otherwise agreed in the guarantee instrument.
Article 8 Where the People's Court decides to suspend execution, it may suspend the implementation of all execution measures, unless otherwise agreed in the guarantee instrument.

Article 9 Where the content of the guarantee instrument is inconsistent with the facts and materially affects the lawful rights and interests of the applying party for execution, the People's Court may resume execution upon the application of the applying party for execution.
Article 10 The period of suspension of execution shall be consistent with the agreement in the guarantee instrument, but shall not exceed one year at the maximum.

Article 11 Where, after the expiration of the period of suspension of execution, the person subject to execution still fails to perform its obligations, or where, during the period of suspension of execution, the guarantor commits acts such as transferring, concealing, selling, or damaging the secured property, the People's Court may, upon the application of the applying party for execution, resume execution and directly rule to execute the secured property or the property of the surety; the guarantor shall not be changed or added as a person subject to execution.
The execution of the secured property or the property of the surety shall be limited to the portion of the property corresponding to the obligations that the guarantor shall perform. Where the person subject to execution has cash or bank deposits that are convenient for execution, such cash or bank deposits shall be executed first.

Article 12 The guarantee period shall be calculated from the date on which the period of suspension of execution expires.
Where the guarantee period is not recorded in the guarantee instrument or the record is unclear, the guarantee period shall be one year.

Article 13 After the expiration of the guarantee period, where the applying party for execution applies to execute the secured property or the property of the surety, the People's Court shall not support it. Where another person provides property security, the People's Court may, upon the application of such person, lift the sealing, seizure, or freezing of the secured property.
Article 14 After the guarantor bears the guarantee liability and brings an action for recourse against the person subject to execution, the People's Court shall accept it.

Article 15 Where the person subject to execution applies to change or lift all or part of the execution measures and provides a guarantee for the performance of the obligations determined in a legally effective legal instrument, these Provisions shall apply mutatis mutandis.

Article 16 These Provisions shall come into force as of March 1, 2018.
Execution guarantees established before these Provisions come into force shall not be governed by these Provisions.
Where the judicial interpretations published by the Supreme People's Court before these Provisions come into force are inconsistent with these Provisions, these Provisions shall prevail.
